metadata.title: fix(admin): reset scroll position on tab navigation
metadata.author: rakdutta

description:
Closes #3748                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  Improves admin UI navigation by automatically scrolling to the top of the content area when switching between tabs, preventing users from landing mid-page on previously scrolled tabs.                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  ## Changes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                       
  **UI Enhancement:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  - Modified `showTab()` in `admin.js` to reset scroll position using `requestAnimationFrame` for reliable DOM-ready timing
  - Added `data-scroll-container` attribute to `<main>` element in `admin.html` to identify the scrollable container                                                                                                                                
  - Wrapped `requestAnimationFrame` in try-catch for graceful degradation in environments without RAF support                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  **Testing:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - Added Playwright test `test_scroll_reset_on_tab_navigation` in `test_admin_ui.py` to verify scroll reset behavior across tab switches                                                                                                           
  - Updated `admin-tag-extraction.test.js` fake timers configuration to include `requestAnimationFrame`                                                                                                                                             
  - All unit tests (996 vitest tests) and Playwright tests pass                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  ## Testing                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  ```bash                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  # Run JS unit tests
  npx vitest run                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  # Run Playwright test
TEST_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000 pytest tests/playwright/test_admin_ui.py -v

reviews.author: vishu-bh
reviews.body:
Thanks @rakdutta for addressing the scroll-retention bug cleanly by resetting the main content container on tab switches, and the data-scroll-container hook makes the behavior explicit rather than relying on a brittle selector. The added Playwright regression also matches the reported user flow well, and the Vitest timer update is a sensible adjustment for the new requestAnimationFrame path.

PR has merge conflicts so once resolved this should be good to approve

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
LGTM — reviewed, rebased, and improved during review. Changes made:

**Squashed & cleaned up commits:**
- 5 messy commits → 1 clean conventional commit
- Removed design spec file that was added then deleted across commits
- Removed AI co-author metadata

**Improved Playwright test reliability:**
- Injected a 5000px spacer div to guarantee the scroll container is actually scrollable (original test set `scrollTop = 500` which gets clamped to 0 by the browser if content is shorter than the viewport)
- Replaced all fixed `wait_for_timeout` sleeps with `wait_for_function` polling — the test now waits for the actual scroll state rather than hoping timing works out

**Added JS unit test coverage:**
- 3 new vitest tests in `admin-tabs.test.js`: scroll reset via `data-scroll-container`, fallback to `main.overflow-y-auto` selector, and graceful handling when no scroll container exists
- Added `afterEach` import, installed synchronous RAF shim for JSDOM (since `vi.useFakeTimers` only fakes Node globals, not JSDOM window APIs)

**Code review notes:**
- Implementation logic is correct — RAF timing for scroll reset after panel reveal is the right approach
- Double try-catch is justified (outer catches missing RAF in JSDOM test env, inner catches querySelector failures)
- No security or performance concerns
- Consistent with existing admin.js patterns

All 999 vitest tests pass.

commits.message:
fix(admin): reset scroll position on tab navigation

Closes #3748

Automatically scroll to the top of the main content area when switching
between admin UI tabs, preventing users from landing mid-page on
previously scrolled tabs.

- Add requestAnimationFrame-based scroll reset in showTab()
- Add data-scroll-container attribute to <main> element
- Add Playwright E2E test for scroll reset behavior
- Add vitest unit tests for scroll reset and fallback selector
- Update fake timers config to include requestAnimationFrame
